Tea-ware in or around Boston?

Dear Bostonians, is there any store you know i can buy tea infusers? It’d be nice to have a specialized place to enjoy the in person experience of checking tea ware. 3

There’s a Mems in Davis I typically go to for tea

I believe Mem Tea is about the only place left around Boston. They are a nice shop and worth the visit.

Mem tea in Davis

Fourthing mem tea, I love their Russian Caravan too. As an aside, it’s a tragedy that there’s not much good tea left around Boston.
